up: Find all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4613212'. For each molecule, return the molecule's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES. Order the results by the molecule's ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4613212' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
